Definition: Integration with national payment systems for government-to-person (G2P), government-to-business (G2B) transactions via data exchange
Comments: The Congo Digital 2025 strategy includes e-citizen digital services. Mobile money is operational (MTN, Airtel). No documented integration of payment systems with the developing government interoperability framework. Payment integration is a planned component of the broader digital transformation.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: The cited World Bank PAD (2022) confirms no interoperability layer existed at appraisal, but the official Ministry of Posts/Telecoms portal (postetelecom.gouv.cg, Mar 2024, corroborated by GIMAC/wearetech.africa) reports active implementation of the CongoPay national interoperable payment platform (with GIMAC and Mediasoft Lafayette) alongside already-functioning digital revenue platforms (Hub digital, timbre electronique). This is more advanced than a mere plan but there is still no evidence of CongoPay or E-PAY-CONGO being integrated into a cross-government data exchange for G2P/G2B, so revised up from Planned to Under development (3), not higher.

Definition: Level of public transparency regarding data exchange operations, governance, and data sharing agreements
Comments: The digital transformation project aims to improve transparency and public service delivery. The EIB/EU project focuses on 'strengthening governance through digitalization.' No public data exchange operations dashboard found. Limited public reporting on system progress.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate. Value Name differs from the scale label — usually cosmetic.
revision_notes: The cited EIB press release only confirms project funding and does not itself evidence transparency practices, so it did not actually support the score. A fresher, more relevant source (UNECA, referencing a June 2026 national data-governance assessment) confirms Congo still lacks an integrated data governance strategy, interoperability framework or public dashboard/annual reporting on the data exchange; a new INS Open Data Portal (announced June 2026) provides some public statistical data but is not the data exchange itself. This corroborates 'Low - Limited Disclosure' from better sources, so the code is confirmed unchanged (2) though on stronger evidential grounds than the original single source.
